Brivio took the lead and completed the first lap in 13m47s to lead by 10.6 seconds from Nuvolari. They were followed by Siena, Barbieri and Trossi.
Magistri in 8th position made a 1m20s pit stop to change spark plugs and dropped to 13th position.

After two laps Brivio was still leading but Nuvolari in second position had closed the gap to seven seconds completing the lap in 13m43s against Brivio's 13m47s.
Siena, third, is 42 seconds behind Nuvolari; Trossi has passed Barbieri for fourth and Dreyfus is sixth.
Brooke retires after one slow lap; Crestini crashes his Bugatti but is only scratched.
Soffietti, seventh, stops for plugs and loses a lot of time; Chambost also pits.

The brakes on Brivio's Alfa Romeo were pulling to the right and the driver had to give way to Nuvolari, who took over the lead on the third lap.
Siena also had problems keeping his Scuderia Subalpina Maserati on the road and Trossi passed him for third position. At the end of the lap Nuvolari was leading by 7.4 seconds.

On the eighth lap Nuvolari improved his time again in 13m19.6s. In an uphill curve, just before Romito near Calafuria, Siena crashed his Scuderia Subalpina Maserati.
Dreyfus thus moved up to fourth and the Scuderia Ferrari team now held the four first positions.
